_comment: Allowlist of intentional parity divergences between the Pascal DSL and our schema/decoder. Each entry must include a 'reason'. Applied by audit.py --gate to suppress known-good findings.

exceptions.reason: wbPerkEffect is a HARD_RAW_VAR (runtime Pascal decider that cannot be statically resolved). The schema uses a hand-written rstruct override that is more useful than raw_fallback and has been validated against real ESM data. Divergence is intentional.

xEdit mislabels BNAM as wbLStringKC(BNAM, 'Comment?') (wbDefinitionsFO76.pas:12120); the '?' was authorial doubt. Verified on SeventySix.esm: the 4-byte payload always equals the owning INFO record's own FormID (self-reference), not an lstring ID — decoding as lstring produced 12 spurious _unresolved markers per coverage sweep. Overridden in fo76.overrides.json (record_patches.INFO) to kind=formid. Divergence is intentional.

xEdit leaves QTFS as wbByteArray(QTFS, 'QTFS - Unknown 2 bytes', 2) — undecoded. Observed 0xffff ('no limit') -> 50 on the seasonal-to-repeatable quest conversion SDOW_SQ01_Graves_Repeatable (0x008F1665) in snapshot 20260710, which reads cleanly as a little-endian u16 repeat limit. Overridden in fo76.overrides.json (record_patches.QUST) to decode as an integer instead of raw bytes. Divergence is intentional.

The live game (header version 293, snapshot 20260914) writes a 2-byte QOST on each objective, between FNAM and NNAM; no wbDefinitions*.pas defines it. Inserted by fo76.overrides.json (record_patches.QUST, op insert_after). Divergence is intentional.

The live game (header version 293, snapshot 20260914) writes an RDWC cubemap path after RDWR in weather region data entries; no wbDefinitions*.pas defines it. Inserted by fo76.overrides.json (record_patches.REGN, op insert_after). Divergence is intentional.

Start Scene's 0-byte 'End Scene Say Greeting' marker is wbEmpty(HTID) in xEdit. 'empty' decodes with an unscoped take, and HTID is also the Dialogue action's Player Headtracking and the Radio action's Play Sound, so a Start Scene action without its own marker took the next action's HTID (0x0053AF54, snapshot 20260914). Overridden in fo76.overrides.json (record_patches.SCEN) to kind=lstring, which is element-scoped and renders the same null. Divergence is intentional.
